hooks.command: AIDD_HOOK_ROOT="$PWD"; while [ "$AIDD_HOOK_ROOT" != / ] && { [ ! -f "$AIDD_HOOK_ROOT/.codex/hooks.json" ] || [ ! -f "$AIDD_HOOK_ROOT/.agents/hooks/pre-tool-use.mjs" ]; }; do AIDD_HOOK_ROOT="$(dirname "$AIDD_HOOK_ROOT")"; done; if [ ! -f "$AIDD_HOOK_ROOT/.agents/hooks/pre-tool-use.mjs" ]; then echo 'AIDD Hook rootを解決できません' >&2; exit 2; fi; node "$AIDD_HOOK_ROOT/.agents/hooks/pre-tool-use.mjs"
hooks.statusMessage: 危険操作と秘密情報へのアクセスを確認中

hooks.command: AIDD_HOOK_ROOT="$PWD"; while [ "$AIDD_HOOK_ROOT" != / ] && { [ ! -f "$AIDD_HOOK_ROOT/.codex/hooks.json" ] || [ ! -f "$AIDD_HOOK_ROOT/.agents/hooks/post-tool-use.mjs" ]; }; do AIDD_HOOK_ROOT="$(dirname "$AIDD_HOOK_ROOT")"; done; if [ ! -f "$AIDD_HOOK_ROOT/.agents/hooks/post-tool-use.mjs" ]; then echo 'AIDD Hook rootを解決できないためpost-edit検証を省略しました' >&2; exit 0; fi; AIDD_PROJECT_DIR="$AIDD_HOOK_ROOT" node "$AIDD_HOOK_ROOT/.agents/hooks/post-tool-use.mjs"
hooks.statusMessage: 編集後の軽量検証を実行中
